blocks.html:
For other than residential occupancies, as defined in the New York City Energy Conservation Code that are three stories or less in height above grade plane, piping to the inlet of a water heater and piping conveying water heated by a water heater shall be insulated in accordance with Section C404 of the New York City Energy Conservation Code. For residential occupancies, as defined in the New York City Energy Conservation Code that are three stories or less in height above grade plane, piping to the inlet of a water heater and piping conveying water heated by a water heater shall be insulated in accordance with Section R403 of the New York City Energy Conservation Code.
